name: SM_Church_PR

textures.channels: tangent normal, OpenGL (green up; flip green on import)
R occlusion, G roughness, B metallic

material_exception: unique BC/N/ORM bake private to this asset (not a row of ART_STANDARD.md section 2): the task for the unclaimed families asks for a baked set per asset, and the surface detail here (see dresses) does not exist in the shared library
pivot: base centre (bbox centre in X/Y, mesh bottom at z = 0), front on -Y
dresses: stone church, 19.5 m long and 17 m to the spire cross: buttressed nave of four bays with lancet windows, lower chancel, round apse with a conical roof, slate roofs at 50 degrees, a bell turret with a slated spire over the west gable
status: source delivered; not imported into Unreal, not bound in families.json
known_weaknesses: Lancets are plain pointed openings with dark leaded panes: no tracery, hood moulds or stained glass (the stained-glass assets can stand in them). Buttresses are two plain stages; there is no plinth course, string course, corbel table or porch, and the west door opening is empty for the church_door leaf. One 4096 px bake covers the whole building, about 100 px/m: it holds at the gameplay camera and is soft at 1 m (a tiling masonry material with trim would be the engine-side answer). Walls are flat slabs with the coursing in the textures; the inside is a dark core, not a room. One convex hull is exported.
